limitations: Direct UBS July 28, 2022 announcement proves the completed BMES acquisition of five development-stage ERCOT projects totaling 700 MW. It does not give the five-SPV schedule, separate legal close, legal buyer, stakes or fifth-asset path. The prior November-2021 acquisition conclusion is superseded as a research finding, not silently rewritten in old history.

The December 10, 2021 UBS page concerns team/strategy establishment. The April 14, 2022 FERC document is a petition submitted by UBS, not a Commission finding: its public PDF page 17 says the petitioner was in late-stage investment discussions. The public petition explains fund/GP/adviser roles; confidential organizational exhibits are not present.
The October 2024 UBS insight indeed says six/930 with 2021 timing and four named locations/730. It is not an executed original-project schedule and does not resolve that chronology/capacity mismatch.

PUCT McAllen registration filed November 17, 2025 directly names ESIF Devco LLC as McAllen's corporate parent and identifies five other affiliates across pages 6 and 9. Affiliate listing alone does not establish all affiliate direct/indirect equity percentages or the original BMES acquisition membership.

PUCT Ironman March 2026 affidavit, visually checked on PDF page 19, identifies Energy Storage Investment Fund I LP as direct or indirect member and UBS Asset Management (Americas) LLC as investment adviser and attorney in fact. It is not a complete holder register or 99%/1% Devco capitalization schedule. The response's 99/1 and every-SPV wholly-owned assertions are not independently established by the returned PDFs and are not application facts.

ERCOT November-2026 MORA published September 3 lists Al Pastor, Wigeon, Holy ESS, Jarvis and Carambola resource rows and Backbone under planned resources; page 21 was visually checked. MORA is a prospective operating-capacity report, not proof of current equity or exact acquisition/operating dates. Different rating bases must not be used as an executed asset bridge.

SMT's direct February 7, 2024 release discloses an unnamed approximately 400 MW sale; its Mission photo is not a sold-asset schedule. Captona's May 1, 2024 release confirms a closed preferred-equity investment over four projects/728 MW/1.06 GWh and mentions an equity partner but does not disclose that partner, the legal preferred-equity holder/layer, stakes, control or cutoff ownership.

No complete original-five schedule, fifth-asset transfer chain or current legal holder/fund chart was obtained. Preserve the raw model hypothesis separately and retain terminal DEFERRED only; do not create a synthetic portfolio, duplicate SPVs or infer current owners.
